descriptionChirho: The proper noun Makkedah, a Canaanite city in the Shephelah lowlands, prominent in Joshua's southern campaign (Josh 10, 12, 15). All three clusters are the identical toponym with different prepositional frames: bare/locative ('Makkedah / at-Makkedah'), conjunctive ('and-Makkedah'), and ablative ('from-Makkedah'). Uniformly rendered across languages: English 'Makkedah', Spanish 'Maqueda/Maqueda', Hindi 'Makkeda (मक्केदा)', Arabic 'Maqida (مَقيدَةَ)', Korean 'Maggeoda (막게다)/Magada (마거다)', Swahili 'Makeda'. As a proper name, no semantic distinction exists between occurrences; prepositional variation is purely grammatical.
